summary: Iter 165 — 'Aperçu de l'accueil' (Home preview) modal on /admin/home-categories. End-to-end frontend PASS. Orange home-preview-btn visible; opens home-preview-modal showing 19 preview-section-<key> blocks in the saved order. Taxi block renders 16 taxi tiles (visible_home=true from service_categories) PLUS the 'Tous les Taxis' tile. Delivery block renders its visible CMS tiles. Non-tile blocks (promo, parcel/Colis & Coursier, marketplace, medical, bid, genie, video, parking, giftcards, carpool, tracking) correctly show the 'Bloc dynamique' placeholder. Close button + backdrop both close the modal. Hiding section-toggle-nearby removes preview-section-nearby from the modal; re-enabling restores it. No runtime errors overlay. Final state: nearby visible=ON (restored).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminHomeCategories.js HomePreviewModal correctly derives visibleSections from secLayout.filter(s.visible) — order/visibility 100% mirrors backend home_sections.

PreviewTile tile factory for taxi maps service_categories with active!==false && visible_home===true, sorted by display_order, then appends the 'Tous les Taxis' more-tile — matches the public Home behaviour.
TILE_SECTIONS set (taxi, delivery, ondemand, beauty, pet, carcare, towing, nearby) used to decide tile-grid vs 'Bloc dynamique' placeholder; consistent with UserHome render logic.
Backdrop click closes modal via onClick on the outer fixed inset-0 wrapper with stopPropagation on inner card — clean implementation, no event leakage observed.
Pre-existing console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' originates from /login (not the preview); unrelated to this iteration and should be ignored per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home-preview modal lives in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminHomeCategories.js (HomePreviewModal + PreviewTile). Testids: home-preview-btn (open), home-preview-modal (container), home-preview-close (X), preview-section-<key> for each visible block. TILE_SECTIONS={taxi,delivery,ondemand,beauty,pet,carcare,towing,nearby}; everything else renders 'Bloc dynamique'. Taxi tiles come from adminAPI.listServiceCategories() (service_categories collection), other sections from items (home_categories CMS). Section visibility/order driven by secLayout from homeCategoriesAPI.adminSections() → backend home_sections collection. Final state at end of test: nearby section visible=ON, default 19-key section order preserved.
